sn46.57:2.3: It’s when a mendicant develops the perception of a skeleton together with the awakening factor of mindfulness …
sn46.57:2.4: and equanimity, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn46.57:2.5: When the perception of a skeleton is developed and cultivated in this way you can expect one of two results: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
